evidence: USER_PREFERENCE_UPDATE_AFTER_RESULT_EXPOSURE; retrospective risk-preference review, no fresh validation claim
objective: Measure worst trade loss, worst5pct trade mean, and actual cash-account maximum drawdown; allow explicit return sacrifice. Prediction MSE, perfect classification, simultaneous return outperformance and adjacent parameter-region gates are NOT required for a risk-control candidate.
policy_pool: Existing frozen fixed [3,5,7.5,10,12.5,15,20]pct and ATR [1,1.5,2,2.5,3] grids only, plus the previously frozen single MCB MFE>=5pct then close<=entry profit-protection policy. No new visual rules or thresholds.
event_selection: Amended before new account results, after user capital-reuse clarification and the discovery event screen. At most three simple representatives per route: (1) smallest worst-trade loss, tie highest mean advantage; (2) best worst5pct mean, tie highest mean advantage; (3) highest mean advantage among policies improving both worst-trade loss and worst5pct mean. Deduplicate. If no policy improves worst trade (Slow), retain only best-tail comparator and explicitly label it. Include existing MCB profit_0 in the same pool; IFCGR inherits the OGR choices. Numerical ties within 1e-12. This is a bounded frontier, not proof of global minimum account cost.
account_selection: Full cash replay from registered start with original entries/rank/sizing/fees, separate OGR resets. Compare discovery and consumed temporal windows and full window. No MSE admission gate. Report non-dominated return/drawdown/worst-trade alternatives, cost in CAGR percentage points per drawdown point saved, and no-financing audit. User return-cost preference, if supplied, controls recommendation; it is not used to tune parameters.
hard_truth_constraints: Do not assume fills below liquidity limits, negative cash clipping, future information, or erased source defects. ATRDR production-prefix quarantine remains a numerical reliability limitation, not a statistical hurdle. Fast exits must regenerate upstream capacity and route allocation. No deployment or entry/capital-weight changes.
visual_freeze: The original visual hypotheses, representations and negative information-test results stay unchanged. A useful simple risk intervention need not be called an informative visual mechanism.
latest_user_preference: 先截住极端损失，在有效方案内尽量少牺牲收益；释放现金按现有信号继续交易，计入后续交易和仓位变化。
capital_reuse: Replay complete existing opportunities from the registered account start. Preserve rank, capacity, router, fees and cash constraints. Report direct exit PnL, changed-quantity PnL, newly funded PnL, cancelled-event PnL, reconciling to terminal account NAV. Subsequent returns include actual simulated reuse only; no hypothetical future cross-strategy allocator profit.
